title: Rigs — Crewed Vehicles for D&D 5e
description: Crewed vehicles (rigs) for dnd5e: board and disembark from the token HUD, crew stations (pilot / gunner / engineer / crew) that roll with each character's own numbers, role actions (steer, ram, evasive, stomp, vent heat, fire weapon, aimed shot, repair, brace…), heat, damage thresholds and AC/hull by size bracket, a rig bar and a Rig tab. The Bad Eden rig engine, standalone — do NOT enable alongside bbttcc-factions (Bad Eden worlds already run it).

conflicts.reason: Bad Eden already runs this rig engine (bbttcc-core + bbttcc-factions)

recommends.reason: evasive / aimed shot / hold position advantage effects and auto damage
